verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a general import capability and a Markdown/Obsidian import path that creates one object per Markdown file. A hands-on report calls Markdown import from Logseq/Obsidian painful (one .md file at a time, a confusing zip option), which limits the Markdown path rather than contradicting it. missing for 10: documented Notion, Evernote and Roam importers, evidence that links, structure and attachments survive import, and smooth bulk Markdown import.
